import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'research-agent'})
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
 'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse(t):
    o=[]
    for l in t.splitlines():
        if l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')) and l[16] in (' ','A'):
            o.append(dict(rec=l[:6].strip(),name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),ch=l[21],num=int(l[22:26]),
                xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),b=float(l[60:66])))
    return o
A=parse(S.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/9FVU.pdb',timeout=120).text)
D=parse(S.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q5U4P2-F1-model_v6.pdb',timeout=120).text)
fe=[a for a in A if a['res']=='FE'][0]['xyz']
akgat=[a for a in A if a['res']=='AKG']; akg=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in akgat])
def fasta(acc): return ''.join(S.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta',timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
ASPHD1=fasta('Q5U4P2'); ASPH=fasta('Q12797')
b62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ln=b62.strip().split('\n');cols=ln[0].split();BL={}
for r in ln[1:]:
    p=r.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): BL[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def nw(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b);NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    tM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);tx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);ty=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);tx[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);ty[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=BL.get((ai,b[j-1]),-1)
            o=(M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(o));M[i,j]=o[k]+s;tM[i,j]=k
            o2=(M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge);k2=int(np.argmax(o2));Ix[i,j]=o2[k2];tx[i,j]=k2
            o3=(M[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k3=int(np.argmax(o3));Iy[i,j]=o3[k3];ty[i,j]=k3
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));P=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0: P.append((i,j));ns=tM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=int(ns)
        elif st==1: ns=tx[i,j];i-=1;st=int(ns)
        else: ns=ty[i,j];j-=1;st=2*int(ns)
    return P[::-1]
pairs=nw(ASPHD1,ASPH); m_a2d={j:i for i,j in pairs}
caA={a['num']:a['xyz'] for a in A if a['name']=='CA' and a['ch']=='A' and a['rec']=='ATOM'}
caD={a['num']:a['xyz'] for a in D if a['name']=='CA'}
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,Sv,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T));R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T;return R,qc-R@pc
cur=[(i,j) for i,j in pairs if j in caA and i in caD and j>=560]
for cut in [6.,4.,3.,2.5,2.5]:
    P=np.array([caD[i] for i,j in cur]);Q=np.array([caA[j] for i,j in cur]);R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
    dev=np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1);cur=[c for c,dd in zip(cur,dev) if dd<cut]
P=np.array([caD[i] for i,j in cur]);Q=np.array([caA[j] for i,j in cur]);R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
rmsd=float(np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1)**2).mean()))
for a in D: a['sx']=R@a['xyz']+t
plddt={a['num']:a['b'] for a in D if a['name']=='CA'}
print(f'Superposition: {len(cur)} CA pairs, RMSD {rmsd:.2f} A\n')

# ---- (A) rotamer-reach test: can ANY ASPHD1 side chain reach the Fe position? ----
REACH={'HIS':3.3,'ASP':2.5,'GLU':3.8,'CYS':1.9,'TYR':6.1,'SER':1.5,'THR':1.5,'ASN':2.5,'GLN':3.8,'MET':3.0}
IDEAL=2.25   # Fe-N/O bond length
rows=[]
cb={}
for a in D:
    if a['name']=='CB': cb[a['num']]=a
for num,a in cb.items():
    rn=a['res']
    if rn not in REACH: continue
    dcb=float(np.linalg.norm(a['sx']-fe))
    if dcb>11: continue
    reachable = dcb <= REACH[rn]+IDEAL
    rows.append(dict(res=f'{AA3[rn]}{num}', type=rn, CB_to_Fe=round(dcb,2),
                     max_reach=round(REACH[rn]+IDEAL,2), can_reach_Fe=reachable, pLDDT=round(plddt[num])))
rt=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('CB_to_Fe')
pd.set_option('display.width',200)
print('== Rotamer-reach test: every polar ASPHD1 side chain whose CB lies within 11 A of the Fe site ==')
print(rt.head(16).to_string(index=False))
print('\nResidues that could coordinate Fe in ANY rotamer:',
      ', '.join(rt[rt.can_reach_Fe].res.tolist()) or 'NONE')
clsc=rt[rt.can_reach_Fe & rt.type.isin(['HIS','ASP','GLU','CYS'])]
print('   of which classical 2OG-oxygenase ligand types (His/Asp/Glu/Cys):',
      ', '.join(clsc.res.tolist()) or 'NONE')

# ---- (B) 2OG pocket: polar contacts vs steric clashes ----
polar=set('NOS')
pc=[];cl=[]
for a in D:
    for la in akgat:
        d=float(np.linalg.norm(a['sx']-la['xyz']))
        if d<3.4 and a['name'][0] in polar and la['name'][0] in polar: pc.append((round(d,2),f"{AA3.get(a['res'],'X')}{a['num']}",a['name'],la['name']))
        if d<3.0 and (a['name'][0]=='C' and la['name'][0]=='C'): cl.append((round(d,2),f"{AA3.get(a['res'],'X')}{a['num']}",a['name'],la['name']))
print('\n== 2OG site in superposed ASPHD1 ==')
print(' polar contacts (<3.4 A, N/O-N/O) to the transferred 2OG:')
for x in sorted(set(pc)): print('   ',x)
print(' carbon-carbon steric clashes (<3.0 A):', sorted(set(cl)) if cl else 'none')
# cavity: ASPHD1 atoms within 8 A of Fe
nb=sum(1 for a in D if np.linalg.norm(a['sx']-fe)<8)
nbA=sum(1 for a in A if a['rec']=='ATOM' and a['ch']=='A' and np.linalg.norm(a['xyz']-fe)<8)
print(f' heavy atoms within 8 A of metal site: ASPHD1 {nb}  vs ASPH {nbA}  (similar packing -> cavity retained)')

# ---- (C) domain architecture / substrate module ----
cov=[j for i,j in pairs]
print('\n== ASPH residues covered by the ASPHD1 alignment ==')
print(' ASPH aligned range:',min(cov),'-',max(cov),'; ASPH 315-558 (TPR + N-term) aligned positions:',sum(1 for j in cov if j<560))
f=S.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q12797.json?fields=ft_domain,ft_repeat,ft_transmem',timeout=60).json()
for ftr in f.get('features',[]):
    print('  ASPH',ftr['type'],ftr['location']['start']['value'],'-',ftr['location']['end']['value'],ftr.get('description',''))
f2=S.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q5U4P2.json?fields=ft_domain,ft_repeat,ft_transmem,cc_function,go',timeout=60).json()
for ftr in f2.get('features',[]):
    print('  ASPHD1',ftr['type'],ftr['location']['start']['value'],'-',ftr['location']['end']['value'],ftr.get('description',''))
gos=[(x['database'],x['id'],x['properties'][0]['value']) for x in f2.get('uniProtKBCrossReferences',[]) if x['database']=='GO']
print('\n== UniProt GO cross-references for ASPHD1 (Q5U4P2) ==')
for g in gos: print('  ',g[1],g[2])

# ---- figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5))
ax=axes[0]
sub=rt.head(10).iloc[::-1]
colr=['#2d6a4f' if c else ('#b23a48' if ty in ('HIS','ASP','GLU','CYS') else '#8d99ae') for c,ty in zip(sub.can_reach_Fe,sub.type)]
ax.barh(range(len(sub)),sub.CB_to_Fe,color=colr)
ax.axvline(2.25,color='#1d3557',ls='--',lw=1)
ax.text(2.35,0.3,'Fe-N/O bond 2.25 A',fontsize=8,color='#1d3557')
for k,(v,r,ty) in enumerate(zip(sub.CB_to_Fe,sub.res,sub.type)):
    ax.text(v+0.1,k,f'{v:.1f}',va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sub))); ax.set_yticklabels(sub.res,fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('CB to Fe-site distance after superposition (A)')
ax.set_title('ASPHD1 side chains nearest the ASPH metal site\n(green = can reach Fe in some rotamer)',fontsize=10)

ax2=axes[1]
labels=['ASPH H679\n(Fe ligand 1)','ASPH H725\n(Fe ligand 2)','ASPHD1 R304\n(= H679 position)','ASPHD1 H349\n(= H725 position)','ASPHD1 D345\n(next-best ligand)']
v=[2.23,2.15,
   float(min(np.linalg.norm(a['sx']-fe) for a in D if a['num']==304 and a['name'] in ('NE','NH1','NH2'))),
   float(min(np.linalg.norm(a['sx']-fe) for a in D if a['num']==349 and a['name'] in ('ND1','NE2'))),
   float(min(np.linalg.norm(a['sx']-fe) for a in D if a['num']==345 and a['name'] in ('OD1','OD2')))]
cols2=['#2a6f97','#2a6f97','#b23a48','#2d6a4f','#b23a48']
ax2.bar(range(5),v,color=cols2)
ax2.axhspan(1.9,2.4,color='#2a6f97',alpha=.15)
for i,x in enumerate(v): ax2.text(i,x+.08,f'{x:.2f}',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xticks(range(5)); ax2.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=7.5)
ax2.set_ylabel('donor atom to Fe distance (A)')
ax2.set_title('One of two ASPH Fe(II) ligands is retained in ASPHD1;\nthe His679 position is an arginine 4.0 A away',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
